items.summary: Risk disposition: blocked for public beta, full launch, rights-dependent monetization, alert expansion, and security-sensitive releases; conditional for ordinary reversible growth that preserves consent, disclosures, provenance, claims, platform-policy, and data boundaries. Evidence: Woot terms do not establish redistribution or commercial display rights; 0 of 4 launch-readiness tasks are closed; accuracy, security, measurement, attribution, and owner gates remain incomplete. Compliance is technical-only at 35 pass, 18 fail, and 6 unknown. Exact decision: keep the gated product private and preview-only; keep rights outreach unsent pending human-counsel review and owner authorization. Do not claim certification, revenue, ROI, or causal lift.

Progress: 0 of 4 tasks closed; all 4 remain open. Existing evidence includes official API, terms, support, repository/configuration, privacy, cookie-policy, and draft-terms artifacts, but none satisfies its deliverable. Do not close tasks without direct evidence. Next evidence action: attach and review one consolidated read-only bundle containing the field-level rights matrix, deployed data-flow and retention table, log/vendor/incident inventory, consent and GA4 configuration evidence, accuracy/freshness controls, and rollback evidence.

Woot API deal and price-history data: blocked. Missing written permission or API agreement, field-level provenance and permitted uses, storage/caching/display/derivative/alert rights, attribution, freshness, correction, takedown, trademark/image/price limits, and affiliate or advertising terms. Smallest next action: complete the internal counsel packet and obtain human-counsel review before any owner-authorized request. User alert rules and sync results: evidence_needed; missing data inventory, identifiers, retention, deletion/correction/access workflow, processor terms, notification consent, and unsubscribe behavior. Smallest next action: produce the read-only deployed/repository data-flow and retention table. GA4 analytics: evidence_needed; missing deployed consent and withdrawal behavior, property/data-sharing settings, retention, vendor disclosure, and jurisdictional treatment. Smallest next action: capture consent and GA4 configuration evidence without enabling tracking or remarketing. Operational logs and Cloudflare hosting data: evidence_needed; missing log fields, retention/access controls, vendor coverage, incident, subpoena, and request procedures. Smallest next action: produce the read-only log/vendor/incident inventory and route unresolved legal gaps to human counsel.

Do not block ordinary growth solely because telemetry is incomplete. Permit only bounded reversible work that adds no credentials, permissions, dependencies, new data collection, or cross-site behavior and preserves existing consent, disclosures, affiliate disclosures, provenance, claims, copyright/trademark, platform-policy, and age-sensitive boundaries. Keep complicated.work, deadlymaracas.com, and driveford.net parked, private, and preview-only until each has dated owner, preview/build, compliance, security, measurement-boundary, rollback, and explicit-blocker evidence.
